decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (1229.02.01 received 22 April 2011 and 1229.02.02 C showing revised height received 15 June 2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The two side windows and the side door hereby approved shall be finished in obscure glazing before the development hereby approved is first occupied and the two windows shall be fixed shut below a level of 1.7 metres above internal finished floor level.  These arrangements shall be permanently retained.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension and single storey rear extension to the house.
